source_metadata.exact_title: IMpower150 Final Exploratory Analyses for Atezolizumab Plus Bevacizumab and Chemotherapy in Key NSCLC Patient Subgroups With EGFR Mutations or Metastases in the Liver or Brain

atoms.canonical_statement: The analysis evaluated final overall survival in EGFR-mutation and baseline liver-metastasis subgroups and post hoc rate/time to new brain metastases in IMpower150.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

atoms.canonical_statement: IMpower150 was an international, open-label, randomized phase 3 trial conducted at 240 centers in 26 countries.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

atoms.canonical_statement: Eligible patients had chemotherapy-naive stage IV metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC, measurable disease by RECIST 1.1, ECOG performance status 0-1, and available tumor tissue.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

population.label: Key eligibility criteria
inclusion_criteria: Chemotherapy-naive stage IV metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC

atoms.canonical_statement: Patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations or ALK translocations generally required progression or intolerance after at least one approved TKI; untreated brain metastases were excluded.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

population.label: Molecular/CNS eligibility conditions
inclusion_criteria: Sensitizing EGFR mutation or ALK translocation after progression/intolerance on approved TKI

atoms.canonical_statement: The intention-to-treat population included 1202 randomized patients: 400 assigned to ABCP, 402 to ACP, and 400 to BCP.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

atoms.canonical_statement: The EGFR-mutated subgroup included 123 patients: 34 ABCP, 45 ACP, and 44 BCP.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

atoms.canonical_statement: Among 91 patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations, 78 had received previous TKI therapy: 22 ABCP, 28 ACP, and 28 BCP.

atoms.canonical_statement: The baseline liver-metastasis subgroup included 161 patients: 52 ABCP, 52 ACP, and 57 BCP.

atoms.canonical_statement: The ABCP arm used atezolizumab 1200 mg IV, bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV, carboplatin AUC 6, and paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 (175 mg/m2 for Asian patients) on day 1 of 21-day cycles during induction.

exposures.details: 175 mg/m2 for Asian patients; ABCP arm

atoms.canonical_statement: The ACP arm consisted of atezolizumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel, without bevacizumab.

provenance.extractor_identifier: GPT-5.6 Sol Evidence Analysis packet repair

atoms.canonical_statement: The BCP comparator arm consisted of bevacizumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel, without atezolizumab.

atoms.canonical_statement: At data cutoff, 100 of 1202 patients (8.3%) developed new brain metastases: 28/400 (7.0%) ABCP, 48/402 (11.9%) ACP, and 24/400 (6.0%) BCP.

atoms.canonical_statement: Small subgroup sample sizes and the exploratory nature of the subanalyses did not allow formal statistical testing; the findings should be interpreted with caution.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that the final exploratory analysis suggested OS benefit for ABCP versus BCP in sensitizing EGFR mutations, including prior TKI failure, and baseline liver metastases, but emphasized cautious interpretation.
